name: Trödelmarkt am GLOBUS Saarbrücken-Güdingen

rhythm.de: Etwa einmal im Monat, meist sonntags
rhythm.en: About once a month, usually on a Sunday

facts: clothes, décor, books and rarities, vintage finds
parking on the first and second floors of the multi-storey car park
easy to reach from the A6 and A620
the organiser has been running markets since 1979
notes: Four dates inside the window: 3 and 4 October are a Saturday and a Sunday back to back, the others are Sundays. Nothing for January 2027 yet. 'Eintritt frei' is stated site-wide in the Melan header rather than on this market's page, which is why fee is 0. Stall fees 12 EUR a metre for second-hand, 15 EUR for new goods. Coordinates from Nominatim for Wolfsau 4.

description.de: Etwa einmal im Monat, meist sonntags von 11 bis 18 Uhr, mit überdachten Ständen. Kleidung, Deko, Bücher, Raritäten und Vintage-Funde. Geparkt wird im Parkhaus, Essen und Trinken gibt es vor Ort; Bus 126 hält davor, von der A6 und A620 ist es kurz.
description.en: About once a month, usually on a Sunday from 11 to 6, with covered pitches. Clothes, décor, books, rarities and vintage finds. Parking is in the multi-storey car park and there is food and drink on site; bus 126 stops outside and it is a short run from the A6 and A620.
